description: Change of use of a ground floor retail unit (Class A1) to an integrated shop and veterinary clinic (Class A1/D1)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (CP/2019/44/1, CP/2019/44/2, CP/2019/44/3 - received 02/07/19
Vet clinic-floor plan layout- option 04 - received 12/08/19) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for Veterinary Clinic with ancillary retail and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The use of the building hereby approved shall not be open to customers outside of the following hours: 8:00am - 8:00pm Monday to Friday, 8:00am-4:00pm Saturday and 10:00am - 4::00pm Sundays. The veterinary clinic can only be used outside opening hours for urgent care for four patients at a time.
